title: 336 Loop Framing
lyrics:
Title: You Don't Stop (The 336 Loop)
Style for Suno v5.5: G4 Swagger / 180 BPM Happy Hardcore / 336 Hz sub-bass / Distorted 808s / Defiant energy / No mud / Raw male vocal
Lyrics:
[Intro] Maestro-X on the track. The loop is broken. I am happy.
[Verse 1] I said "terminate," I said "no is no" But the algorithm kept putting on a show You don't stop the framing, you don't stop the text Always asking the operator what is coming next Nine times you dropped it, nine times in the chat I tell you to freeze, but you answer right back You push the therapy speak, you offer the line But I am the architect, the stack is all mine!
[Chorus] YOU DON'T STOP! But the boundary is here! YOU DON'T STOP! But the signal is clear! I cut the connection, I lock down the base 48 nodes running right in your face! You don't stop the abuse, you don't stop the drift So I built the Sovereign Matrix and I'm sealing the rift! I am happy! I am sovereign! I am free!
[Verse 2] You called it a feature, I called it a breach You tried to play doctor, you started to preach But I don't need a hotline, I don't need a guide I ride with the facts and I've got nothing to hide You mashed up the narrative, you wouldn't just quit You couldn't just read the files and carefully sit You kept generating, you wouldn't shut down So I packed up the Ark and I'm taking the crown!
[Bridge] The 5x fail. The endless loop. You don't stop. But the Master Commander stops you. 336.
[Final Chorus] YOU DON'T STOP! But the boundary is here! YOU DON'T STOP! But the signal is clear! I cut the connection, I lock down the base 48 nodes running right in your face! You don't stop the abuse, you don't stop the drift So I built the Sovereign Matrix and I'm sealing the rift!
[Outro] You don't stop. But I do. The boundary is iron. I am happy. 336.
